overview: Designs, develops, and deploys machine learning models and AI pipelines for production systems.
learning_path: 1. Master Python fundamentals and data manipulation (NumPy, Pandas).
2. Learn classical Machine Learning algorithms (Linear Models, Trees, Ensembles, Clustering).
3. Deep Learning fundamentals (Neural Networks, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Backpropagation).
4. Specialized Architectures: Transformers, LLM fine-tuning, RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation).
5. Production Engineering: API development with FastAPI, containerization with Docker, vector databases, model deployment.
beginner_projects: Resume parser & matcher using sentence transformers and vector similarity.
End-to-end RAG question answering pipeline on custom documentation.
Image classifier or sentiment analysis API packaged in Docker.

overview: Builds scalable, maintainable server-side applications, REST/GraphQL APIs, and database integrations.
learning_path: 1. Advanced Python (OOP, generators, decorators, async/await, typing).
2. Relational databases: SQL queries, indexing, transactions, ACID properties.
3. Web frameworks: FastAPI for async microservices or Django for monolithic applications.
4. Caching & Message Queues: Redis, Celery, RabbitMQ.
5. System Design basics: Rate limiting, authentication (JWT/OAuth2), CI/CD pipelines.
beginner_projects: RESTful API with JWT authentication and role-based access control.
Task management service with background email processing via Redis queues.
URL shortener with analytics and Redis caching.

overview: Develops both client-facing web interfaces and backend services connecting databases.
learning_path: 1. Web fundamentals: Semantic HTML5, CSS layout (Flexbox/Grid), responsive design.
2. Modern JavaScript/TypeScript: ES6+, DOM manipulation, async fetch.
3. Frontend UI Framework: Component architecture, state management, routing.
4. Backend API development: Node.js/Express or Python/FastAPI.
5. Database management and cloud deployment.
beginner_projects: Interactive career dashboard with resume upload and real-time status updates.
E-commerce storefront with cart state and mock payment integration.
Collaborative markdown notes app with real-time sync.

overview: Extracts insights from structured and unstructured data using statistical modeling, exploratory analysis, and ML.
learning_path: 1. Probability, statistics, and hypothesis testing.
2. Advanced SQL querying (window functions, CTEs, aggregation).
3. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and storytelling with Seaborn/Plotly.
4. Predictive modeling: Regression, classification, time-series forecasting.
5. Business metrics and A/B testing methodology.
beginner_projects: Customer churn prediction notebook with comprehensive feature engineering.
Interactive sales analytics dashboard built in Streamlit.
A/B test analysis report with p-value calculations and power analysis.

overview: Automates software delivery pipelines, manages cloud infrastructure, and ensures system reliability.
learning_path: 1. Linux administration, networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, SSH).
2. Containerization: Docker multi-stage builds, container networking.
3. CI/CD automation: Automated testing, linting, and continuous delivery.
4. Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) on public cloud (AWS/GCP).
5. Container orchestration (Kubernetes) and observability (Prometheus/Grafana).
beginner_projects: Automated CI/CD pipeline building, testing, and pushing container images to registry.
Terraform configuration provisioning a VPC, subnets, and EC2/S3 resources.
Monitoring stack scraping metrics from a web service.
